howToPlay: Use the Speed of 800 and high health to close the distance quickly. Utilize T-Bone Missile to heal while dealing damage or Stomper to control enemies with slows and stuns. Rely on Berserker or Tough Guy to turn the tide when your health is low.
gears: Use SPEED and HEALTH to capitalize on your durability, and use SUPER CHARGE to gain your powerful movement ability more often.
trait: This brawler is perfect for aggressive players who excel at close-range combat and managing low-health risk-reward mechanics.
